reason: It's a brand-new name I've never seen, and a creator shout-out isn't the same as hundreds of real reviews. I'd also be signing up for a filter subscription I'd probably forget about, just to fix hotel water a few times a year.
objection: No track record or independent proof the filter actually works as claimed, plus another auto-renewing plan I'll forget to cancel.
would_change_my_mind: Hundreds of verified reviews and independent lab test results for the filter, with a one-time filter purchase option instead of a subscription.
